title: Seller Performance Standing: Applying the Clean-Span Relief Rate Around the Warning Threshold
content:
**Band rule.** How the clean-span relief rate is applied depends on where the active points stand against the warning points threshold of the seller's level: when they are at or above the threshold and the clean span is six months or more, the points above the threshold come off in full and the threshold points are multiplied by the clean-span relief rate; when they are at or above the threshold and the clean span is shorter, the threshold points are multiplied by the clean-span relief rate and the points above the threshold by twice that rate, and the two products are added; when they are below the threshold, all the active points are multiplied by the clean-span relief rate.

The warning points threshold of Seller Performance Standing is 8 points at every level (Below Standard Level, Developing Seller Level, Standard Level, Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level). "Threshold points" are those 8 points; "points above the threshold" are the active points less 8.

## The clean span

For clean-span relief, whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date, and the clean span is the number of whole months that have passed from the event date of the most recent violation recorded on the standing record to the handling date. A span of exactly six whole months counts as six months or more; five whole months and any number of days is shorter.

## The three bands

| Active points | Clean span | Relief points before rounding |
|---|---|---|
| 8 or more | 6 whole months or more | the active points less 8, in full, plus 8 multiplied by the rate |
| 8 or more | fewer than 6 whole months | 8 multiplied by the rate, plus the active points less 8 multiplied by twice the rate |
| 7 or fewer | any | the active points multiplied by the rate |

The relief points the band rule gives are rounded down to a whole point, the products being worked to four decimal places before any rounding down.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, with a rate of 0.25)

- 12 active points, clean span of 7 months: 4 points above the threshold come off in full; 8 multiplied by 0.25 is 2.0000. Relief points: 4 plus 2, which is 6.
- 12 active points, clean span of 4 months: 8 multiplied by 0.25 is 2.0000; 4 multiplied by 0.5 is 2.0000; added, 4.0000. Relief points: 4.
- 7 active points, any span: 7 multiplied by 0.25 is 1.7500, rounded down to 1.
- Exactly 8 active points, clean span of 6 months: no points above the threshold; 8 multiplied by 0.25 is 2.0000. Relief points: 2.
